title: Prevalence of Liver Fibrosis and Cirrhosis in Patients With Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck
brief_summary: Tobacco and alcohol are the two major risk factors for upper respiratory tract cancer (VADS).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient over 18 years of age
* Supported in the department of Orl \& CCF or Maxillo-Faciale surgery of the CHU d'Amiens
* Histological diagnosis of epidermoid carcinoma:

  * From the oral cavity
  * From the oropharynx
  * Hypopharynx
  * Larynx
* Any stage of cancer
* Affiliation to a social security scheme

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient already treated previously for a cancer of the VADS
* Patient referred to in Articles L. 1121-5 to L. 1121-8 and L. 1122-1-2 of the Public Health Code
condition: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck
